title.narrative: Funafuti Water Supply and Sanitation Project

description.narrative: The project has the dual objectives of (i) enhancing the well-being and quality of life for the residents of Funafuti atoll by providing improved drinking water supply and sanitation services; and (ii) building the resilience of Funafuti residents to the projected impacts of climate change. For the first time, Tuvalu will construct a reticulated water supply network, which will benefit more than half of the country's population.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved drinking water supply and sanitation services that are climate- adapted, affordable, and resilient provided in Funafuti.

At least 36% of households have access to safe and resilient piped-water supply system, including 50% of households headed by women. Progress/Status: This indicator will be met upon the completion of the piped water supply system.
CW01 - Main Civil Works Package The design works were tendered on 10 October 2025. The original bid submission closing date was 9 December 2025. Addendum 11 extended the bid submission deadline to 22 January 2026, and Addendum 12 further extended the deadline to 13 February 2026.
CS01 - Project Implementation Assistance Consultants (PIAC) PIAC is being recruited under the Pacific Roster of Firms framework. A Request for Quotation (RFQ) was issued to four firms on 29 August 2025. Proposals closed on 17 October 2025, and technical and financial evaluations have been completed. Contract negotiations are currently ongoing.
The Project Management Unit comprises five (5) individual positions to support the EA/IA in managing project works. The Project Accountant, Environmental and Social Safeguards Specialist, Communications Expert, and Gender Expert are at the contract negotiation stage. Shortlisting and recruitment for the Project Manager position are ongoing.
Gender: PIAC (intl) and PMU (national ) Gender focals will manage implementation, monitoring and reporting of the gender targets and activities contained in the DMF+GAAP. An orientation by ADB on the intended gender deliverables will be conducted once consultants are onboard.
Fortnightly progress meetings will resume with the Public Works Department once the PMU and CSC firm is contracted. These meetings serve as a platform to track project progress and to identify and address emerging issues.
